Disposition

I verified the repository at exact commit 2b8f1ae0ea8c514bd333c45fe11275a2fabfbb81; I did not substitute a newer revision. The retained direction indeed characterizes ROAD as beating RAW but losing to NEVER and barely beating SHAM. The B2 definition also explicitly says that its comparison was not a renewed link-function test and describes eligible exposure as an offset rather than a literal hazard; its policy map is nevertheless the exponential cumulative-exposure transform. I did not consult or use the quarantined B3 package.

The prospective construction has two distinct dispositions because one sentence is ambiguous:

Under the natural interpretation that only the freely selected parameters q,p,r must lie in Q, while 1−(1−r)
4
 is evaluated exactly, the formal result is a material exposure-linked advantage of approximately 0.125331.

Under the literal interpretation that every realized event probability must itself lie in Q, the feasible exposure-linked family collapses to three bases, and the result becomes a material per-opportunity advantage of approximately 0.094475.

Thus, as written, the object does not have a unique answer. That is the strongest formal counterexample.

After repairing that ambiguity in the intended free-parameter direction, the algebra is internally sound, the headroom and registered q-heterogeneity gates pass, and the exponential family beats the diagonal per-opportunity family. But this is a deliberately favorable physical-age positive control, not evidence that the exponential link is uniquely warranted: a simpler one-parameter physical event-rate map reaches the unrestricted two-stratum ceiling exactly.

What this derivation assumes

The identity requires renewal to reset the remaining service lifetime to eight rather than append eight additional ticks. The shell wording strongly suggests reset semantics. A consistent before-action versus after-action reward convention only phase-shifts the eight covered ticks and does not change the long-run ratio. Granting the action tick plus eight additional ticks would instead be a nine-tick service law and would invalidate the stated formula.

Repeated premature renewals are not omitted. They appear through min(T,8): an early renewal incurs another cost and discards or overwrites residual lifetime rather than accumulating extra service.

There is an endogenous age variable—time since the last real renewal—even though there is no exogenous hidden task state. Since both frozen families are state-blind constant-probability policies, this age process is shared and is not a treatment confound.

11. Service age and an excluded dominant policy

The host necessarily contains endogenous service age. If age-conditioned policies were admissible, a deterministic policy could renew exactly every eight physical ticks:

at every eighth opportunity in the Δ=1 stratum;

at every second opportunity in the Δ=4 stratum.

It would achieve

That policy lies outside the frozen constant-Bernoulli families, so it is not a valid comparator for the registered question. But it shows that the observed family gap is about memoryless rate linking under deliberately forced premature renewals, not about optimal renewal control.

There is no hidden steady-state confound: the renewal formula handles the endogenous age distribution exactly. There is instead a deliberate policy-class restriction whose claim ceiling must remain explicit.

12. Equal physical time and matched work

The equal mean of the two stratum returns is honest as a frozen 50/50 physical-tick target distribution. It is not a statistical average over two independent replicates; there is no sampling uncertainty here.

The dummy-call statement is also honest only in a narrow sense:

both families receive the same number of physical-slot invocations;

they see the same opportunity flags and exposure values;

dummy slots have no reward or state effect.

It is not matched actionable work. The spacing-one stratum has four times as many legal event decisions and Bernoulli executions per unit physical time. That is the intended treatment contrast. Because compute cost and learning are absent from the objective, the mismatch is not a return confound, but “matched work” should not be used to imply matched numbers of legal actions or stochastic draws.

Equal 50/50 weighting is not a knife-edge source of the reported sign. Reoptimizing both families with 25% versus 75% weight on the spacing-one stratum gives an exposure advantage of approximately 0.1412; reversing those weights gives approximately 0.0705. Both remain above 1/32. At degenerate one-stratum limits, however, the link distinction disappears or becomes nonmaterial, so no mixture-independent claim is warranted.

13. Complete branch map
Branch	Exact disposition
Family collapse	Rejected. The interior policy vectors never coincide.
Failure of direct-return headroom	Rejected. Both strata beat KEEP and their fixed-q shells by large margins.
One robust global operating point	Rejected in the frozen raw-q coordinate; supported exactly in the physically natural h=q/Δ coordinate.
Per-opportunity advantage	Rejected under the intended free-parameter grid; selected materially under the literal all-realized-probabilities grid.
Exposure-linked advantage	Selected materially under the intended free-parameter grid: 0.1253309173>1/32.
No material link difference	Rejected for the frozen P-versus-E comparison under either grid reading; selected for exponential exposure versus the linear common-physical-rate comparator, whose difference is only 0.0172619858.
14. Smallest sufficient correction and exact work

Three sentences are enough to make the original object internally single-valued:

Real renewal resets a nonstacking lifetime to exactly eight service-bearing physical slots. The grid Q constrains only independently selected q,p,r; transformed probabilities are evaluated exactly without projection. The matched shell is evaluated at the candidate’s fixed event probabilities and is not independently optimized.

For the broader investment question, add one comparator:

q
Δ
	​

(h)=min(1,Δh),h∈Q.

No result-bearing stochastic experiment is scientifically necessary. Exact enumeration adds only an arithmetic certificate of:

grid argmax indices;

near-optimal-set membership;

threshold comparisons;

absence of ties;

the transformed-grid ambiguity.

The smallest certificate requires 34 diagnostic evaluations—17 grid points for each stratum—and 17 additional spacing-four evaluations at the transformed exposure probabilities. The per-opportunity global scores reuse the diagnostic table. Thus there are 51 distinct J-evaluations, or 68 reported candidate-score rows if diagnostic, per-opportunity, and exposure-family tables are all emitted separately. There are no seeds, horizons, confidence intervals, or Monte Carlo runs.

Claim ceiling

After the grid repair, the exact defensible claim is:

On this single nonstacking eight-physical-tick renewal unit, for spacings one and four, equal physical-time weighting, state-blind constant event probabilities, and the frozen free-parameter grid, the exponential cumulative-exposure family materially outperforms a single constant per-opportunity probability.

The construction does not establish learned ONLGR value, lease value, rebinding value, task-content value, arbitrary-period validity, variable-population transfer, UAV relevance, or PPO superiority. More sharply, it does not establish exponential-link necessity: a simpler one-parameter common executed-event-rate family reaches the unrestricted grid ceiling and is not materially separated from the exponential family.
